test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**fassinate**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word if corrected results in the formation of 'fascinate'.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the correctly formed words:
 
• Fascinate: to attract or interest somebody very much.
 
 
• 
 Example: *I was always fascinated by European culture.*
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the only incorrectly spelt word is:* Fassinate*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__*

 
• The words 'humiliate, ignorant, and intelligent' are correctly spelt.
 
• Let us take a look at the meaning of correctly spelt words:
 
• Humiliate: to make somebody feel very embarrassed.
 
• Ignorant: not knowing about something.
 
• 
 Intelligent: having or showing the ability to understand, learn and think; clever.
